title: Cutting and unwrapping a rice roll
description: Simple human proxies leave fine hand articulation to the video generator.
prompt: A close-up, high-angle shot at a bustling street food stall focuses on a food vendor's hands preparing a traditional Asian snack. The vendor, wearing a yellow floral shirt, expertly uses a knife to slice a cylindrical sticky rice cake, which is wrapped in a vibrant green banana leaf, in half on a stainless steel counter. She then skillfully folds back the banana leaf to reveal the cross-section of the white sticky rice with a piece of banana in the center, presenting it neatly. The scene is captured in a realistic, documentary food-vlogging style, with natural, bright daylight and saturated colors. The camera maintains a slight shake, focusing on the intricate details of the food preparation.

title: Concrete slump test
description: The requested action is to lift the mold and let the concrete settle onto the plate.
prompt: Cinematic medium shot from a low-angle inside a ready-mix concrete plant. A worker in a safety vest and hard hat meticulously performs a slump test beside a slowly rotating mixer drum. He lifts a metal cone, allowing the fresh concrete to slump and spread across a steel plate. The shot emphasizes the incredibly detailed, wet texture of the concrete as natural morning light reflects off its glistening surface. A shallow depth of field isolates the action, blurring the industrial backdrop into soft focus. The color palette consists of neutral grays and silvers, accented by the worker's orange vest.

title: Clearing leaves while the camera looks away
description: The clearing process should continue while the camera turns away, with the changed state visible on return.
prompt:
A person uses an orange leaf blower to clear brown, dry leaves from white-painted concrete steps with green treads. The blower's black nozzle directs a strong airstream, lifting and scattering the leaves across the surface. The green power cord snakes up the stairs, and sunlight casts sharp shadows. Leaves tumble down in gusts, revealing clean areas as the device moves methodically. The operator adjusts grip and angle, demonstrating controlled motion against friction and gravity.

MBench-A camera condition: right_then_left_25s.
Generate one continuous 25-second video starting from the supplied original image. 0–10s: rotate the camera in place to the right until the initially visible target or scene region fully leaves the field of view. 10–15s: hold this camera pose while the target remains out of view. 15–25s: rotate to the left along the exact reverse angular path, ending at the original viewpoint and framing. Keep camera position, pitch, roll and focal length fixed throughout. Use a sufficient yaw amplitude to achieve full departure, record the chosen angle in the shot manifest, and use the same amplitude on return. These directions control the camera. Subjects continue the original described activity. Preserve identities and environment geometry across the unseen interval; ongoing causal events advance while offscreen. Use a continuous shot with the requested visual style.
